name: Launch Opt-In / Register / Log-In — Tag, Confirmation, Access, Nurture Start
template_status: from post-optin-multichannel-stack (opt-in entry trimmed; nurture body stays in the source template)

source.spec: launch-automations.spec.md §3.3 — Opt-in / register / log-in: Form, registration, access request → tag, confirmation, access/log-in, nurture start
source.template: automation-templates/multichannel-automation/post-optin-multichannel-stack.json/.md — trigger, tag guard and delivery framing come from this template
source.capability_note: automation-templates/launch-ghl-probe/GHL-CAPABILITY-NOTE.md — opt-in / register / log-in: Skill 44 engine; CampaignBuilder auto-creates only a Tag Added trigger, so Form Submitted / Funnel Step Submitted needs `caf workflows patch-trigger` or the Tier-4 managed browser

purpose: One entry handler for every launch opt-in surface: an opt-in form, an event/webinar registration, or an access/log-in request. The submit is tagged once, confirmed immediately, given the exact access or log-in it asked for, and handed to the right nurture start. It is the front door of the launch; the long nurture sequence and the reminder cadence are separate workflows.

trigger.primary_event: Form submitted on an opt-in, registration or access-request page
trigger.trigger_build: Not created by CampaignBuilder (Tag Added only). Build with `caf workflows patch-trigger --trigger-json <file>` on the internal API, snapshot before write; Tier-4 managed browser where the engine has no verified payload.

variants.surface: Opt-in form / lead magnet claim / waitlist squeeze page
variants.match: The approved launch plan's opt-in form ID or funnel-step ID. Never inferred from page title or URL text.
variants.confirmation: Lead magnet delivery + what happens next

variants.match: The approved launch plan's registration form ID or funnel-step ID.
variants.nurture_start: launch reminder cadence (event reminders + replay / no-show family)

variants.surface: Access request / log-in request form (membership, portal, course, event access)
variants.match: The approved launch plan's access-request form ID or funnel-step ID. Log-in delivery is the transactional access email; no password is ever sent by this workflow.

entry_conditions: The submitted form resolves to exactly one approved variant binding (form-optin, registration, or access-login)
The contact has not already entered this variant for this campaign (guard tag absent)
The contact is not already a paid buyer for this launch, or the purchase guard exits before any promotional step
exit_conditions: Variant tag written once for this campaign
Access/log-in delivered once where the variant requires it
trigger.reentry: Once per contact per variant per campaign. Guard tags are `launch-optin-started`, `launch-registered-started`, `launch-access-started`; a variant guard present means the workflow does not repeat the tag, confirmation, access delivery or enrollment. Dedupe on form submission identity plus variant, never on 'has any launch tag'.

channels: SMS (confirmation only when the launch plan is email + text and A2P is approved)

dependencies_first.note: Skill 44 refuses to build if these do not exist. Create them before the workflow.

sequence.name: Tag the entry once
sequence.detail: Add the variant tag (`launch-optin`, `launch-registered`, or `launch-access-requested`) plus the matching `*-started` guard. The guard makes the handler idempotent across page refreshes and repeated submits.

sequence.name: Record the opt-in date
sequence.detail: Set `launch_optin_date` to now. This is the date the nurture and reminder families read; it is not a send trigger in this workflow.

sequence.name: Purchase guard before anything promotional
sequence.detail: IF tag `purchased-[offer-id]` is present → do not send promotional copy; exit to the post-sale purchase workflow. ELSE continue. This is the A2 guarantee: a buyer never receives launch promo emails or texts from this handler.

sequence.name: Immediate confirmation
sequence.detail: Variant copy from the approved Skill 50 launch copy: form-optin delivers the lead magnet and what happens next; registration confirms the seat and supplies the calendar/access link; access-login confirms the request and delivers the log-in path. Copy comes from Skill 50; this template wires the sends and does not author them.

sequence.name: Confirmation text
sequence.timing: Immediately, only when email + text launch and A2P approved
sequence.detail: One short confirmation with a reply invitation and STOP opt-out inside the launch send window (default 8 a.m.–9 p.m. recipient local time). Skipped entirely when A2P is not approved; the build plan records the skip and the text stays a draft.

sequence.name: Access / log-in delivery
sequence.timing: Immediately, registration and access-login variants only
sequence.detail: Registration sends the calendar/join link; access-login sends the portal invitation or magic log-in link for the exact purchased or granted access. form-optin skips this node — its access is the lead magnet already delivered. Never send a password.

sequence.name: Nurture start
sequence.detail: Enroll in exactly one variant-appropriate workflow: form-optin → post-optin-multichannel-stack nurture; registration → launch reminder cadence; access-login → access / onboarding follow-up. Never enroll twice; the guard from step 1 prevents it.

sequence.name: Close the entry handler
sequence.detail: The handler is short — no multi-day waits live here. The nurture sequence and the reminder cadence own their own timing.

buyer_suppression.rule: A paid buyer receives no further promotional emails or texts for this launch, from any variant of this handler.
stops: Nurture pitches for an offer already bought or included in the package
does_not_stop: Transactional confirmation, access and log-in notices
The buyer's own onboarding / review / referral sequence
A genuinely different later offer approved in the launch plan

build.engine: Skill 44 internal-API engine (`caf workflows create` / `CampaignBuilder`), with the managed-browser Tier-4 backstop for the trigger
build.api_ceiling: The official GHL API has no workflow create, update, publish or trigger endpoint; its only workflow operation is GET /workflows/. Do not attempt an API-only build.
build.state: Every workflow is created as a draft. Triggers are written `status: draft` and `active` stays gated by CAF_DRAFT_ONLY. Nothing sends, nothing goes live. Live switch-on is a separate client approval.
inputs_required: Approved variant bindings: form ID or funnel-step ID per opt-in / registration / access-login surface
Approved Skill 50 confirmation copy hash per variant
Lead magnet URL, registration calendar/join URL, access/log-in URL
Nurture workflow IDs: post-optin nurture, reminder cadence, access / onboarding follow-up
A2P registration state and launch send window
Location whitelist entry and Firebase refresh token (workflow writes); absent token → Tier-4 browser backstop

quality.wf_checks: WF-1..21 and FAB-QC >= 8.5 apply to the built workflow
assertions: Each variant resolves to one approved form binding; no guessed page or product
Tag + guard written before any send, so a refresh cannot double-send
Purchase guard exits before every promotional node
Access/log-in delivered once; no password is ever sent
SMS node is skipped and recorded when A2P is not approved
Exactly one nurture enrollment per contact and variant
Everything is draft_only; no live switch-on; no client account touched during the build

attributes.ref: Add the variant tag plus the matching `*-started` guard

attributes.condition: email + text launch AND A2P approved

attributes.ref: Enroll in exactly one variant-appropriate workflow

attributes.goal: purchase guard exits to post-sale workflow
attributes.ref: exit to the post-sale purchase workflow
